content.text: You’re a digital creator in Nigeria. Stripe is unavailable. Gumroad payouts are delayed. PayPal blocks your account. Your customers want to pay in USDT, but you need naira. This is not a temporary problem. It’s your operating reality. COREMERCH solves this with [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-what-nobody-tells-14|COREMERCH guide to sovereign]] commerce infrastructure. No platforms. No subscriptions. No middlemen. You own the stack. This guide deploys your digital store today—using GitHub Pages for hosting, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/google-apps-script-digital-commerce-automation-what-actually-15|google]] Apps Script for logic, and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-payments-explained-digital-9|NOWPayments Integration]] for crypto payments. USDT on Tron costs under $0.10 per transaction. Solana averages fractions of a cent. Your customers pay in crypto. You convert to naira via P2P exchanges like Binance or Patricia. This is how you build infrastructure that cannot be blocked.

For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-2. content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Platforms fail because they are not built for your context. Stripe and PayPal operate on terms set by Western markets. Gumroad delays payouts because it’s optimized for dollars, not USDT. Your infrastructure must be sovereign—owned by you, deployed by you, operated by you. GitHub Pages hosts your store for free. Google Apps Script handles backend logic without servers. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain with a 0.5% fee. No KYC. No buyer accounts. The moment payment confirms, the product delivers. This stack is not a workaround. It’s base-layer infrastructure designed for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and beyond. You own the code. You own the data. You own the pipeline.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying, gather your tools. First, a GitHub account for hosting. Second, a NOWPayments API key for crypto payment processing. Third, a Google Drive folder to store your digital products. Fourth, a domain name (optional but recommended for professionalism). Fifth, a P2P exchange account like Binance or Patricia to convert crypto to naira. Do not skip the P2P step—it’s how you liquidate earnings locally. If you’re deploying the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you’ll also need a Cloudflare account for Workers and R2 storage. All these tools are free or low-cost. Your investment is in the infrastructure, not in renting platforms.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start with NOWPayments. Create an account, generate an API key, and configure USDT on Tron or Solana for low fees. Set up a webhook to fire when payment confirms. In Google Apps Script, write a script that listens for this webhook, verifies the transaction, and sends the product download link via email. Upload your digital products to Google Drive and generate shareable links. On GitHub Pages, deploy a simple HTML store with product listings and NOWPayments checkout buttons. Test the pipeline end-to-end before going live. USDT on Tron costs under $0.10 per transaction. Solana is fractions of a cent. Your customers pay in crypto. Your pipeline delivers instantly.
USDT on Tron costs under $0.10 per transaction. Solana averages fractions of a cent. Choose your network based on fee efficiency.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your store to GitHub Pages. Share the live URL with your audience. When a customer buys, NOWPayments verifies the payment on-chain. Your Apps Script webhook triggers, sends the product link, and logs the order in Google Sheets. Convert the USDT to naira via Binance or Patricia. Your first transaction proves the infrastructure works. Document the process for repeatability. If you’re deploying the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97), COREMERCH handles the setup for you. If you’re building yourself, follow the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) step-by-step. Either way, you own the stack after deployment. No platform has access. No subscription is required.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once live, scale methodically. Add more products to your Google Drive folder. Duplicate the Apps Script logic for each new product. Optimize your store’s HTML for faster load times. Configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email deliverability if using the Edge Commerce Stack ($197). Monitor transaction fees—switch to Solana if Tron fees rise. Automate P2P conversions with Binance API integrations. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates for advanced scaling. Download it from https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Your infrastructure is now a revenue engine. Not a cost center. Not a liability. An asset you own.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

To receive crypto payments for your digital products, use NOWPayments. It supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, charges a 0.5% fee, and requires no KYC. Set up a webhook to verify payments on-chain. For low fees, use USDT on Tron (under $0.10 per transaction) or Solana (fractions of a cent). Deploy your store on GitHub Pages and handle backend logic with Google Apps Script. Deliver products via Google Drive. This stack is sovereign—you own it, you control it. No platforms. No subscriptions. Just infrastructure.
NOWPayments’ 0.5% fee is the lowest in crypto payments. No KYC. No buyer accounts. Just instant verification.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Create a GitHub account and NOWPayments API key. 2. Upload your digital products to Google Drive. 3. Write a Google Apps Script to handle payment webhooks and product delivery. 4. Deploy your store to GitHub Pages with NOWPayments checkout buttons. 5. Test the pipeline end-to-end with a test transaction. 6. Share your live store URL with your audience. 7. Convert crypto earnings to naira via Binance or Patricia. 8. Document your process for repeatability. 9. Scale by adding more products and optimizing your stack. 10. Download the Complete Builder Kit ($197) from https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for advanced blueprints and templates.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I convert Bitcoin to naira in Nigeria?

Use P2P exchanges like Binance or Patricia. Create an account, list your Bitcoin for sale, and receive naira directly into your bank account. This method is fast, secure, and widely used in Nigeria. Avoid centralized exchanges with high fees or withdrawal limits.
How long does a USDT payment take compared to PayPal?

USDT payments on Tron or Solana confirm in minutes. NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain instantly. PayPal can take days to process international payments and often blocks accounts in restricted regions. USDT is faster, cheaper, and more reliable for your context.
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?

Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) are deployed for you within 48 hours. If building yourself, follow the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) step-by-step. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all templates and blueprints for non-developers.
What if NOWPayments goes down?

NOWPayments operates on decentralized blockchain networks. If their service is unavailable, your payments still process on-chain. Your Apps Script logic can be configured to use backup payment processors. This stack is designed for resilience, not dependency.
How do I handle refunds with crypto payments?

Refunds are processed manually by sending crypto back to the customer’s wallet. Document refund requests in your Google Sheets order log. Communicate clearly with customers about refund policies. Crypto’s transparency makes this process straightforward.
